input.summary: Extend the Section 2 licences to Corio's affiliates and contractors acting on Corio's behalf
input.comment: [Playbook] We added a provision extending the Section 2 licences to our affiliates and to contractors acting on our behalf, since our playbook requires the licence to cover affiliate and contractor use of the hosted Software. We are happy to fall back to affiliate coverage on written notice to Commerce One if preferred.

ops.text: 2.11 Affiliates and Contractors. The licenses granted to Corio under this Section 2 extend to Corio's affiliates and to contractors acting on Corio's behalf, provided that Corio remains responsible for their compliance with the terms and conditions of this Agreement.
